comment: Seeded with the year's keystone THREADS only. items is deliberately empty for the same reason as J2's: under DFM 134 the Do-Now serves only items from lessons this pupil has COMPLETED, so each item is authored by the lesson that teaches it. Year-One note (his K4 ruling): this cohort arrives with no platform history and no Python, so nothing here assumes a J1 or J2 thread — J3 L1 and L2 establish their own ground first.

kp-platform-j3.label: How this website works
kp-platform-j3.note: First-ever login for this cohort. Established J3 L1; deliberately not inherited from J1.

kp-code-j3.label: The studio code
kp-code-j3.note: The DT room rules taught as what professionals do, and tested by judgement in J3 L1.

kp-py-basics.label: Python from zero: print, variables, running a program
kp-py-basics.note: Established J3 L2, the Year-One lesson added because this cohort has no Python (his K4 taper).

kp-list.label: Lists: holding a set of values

kp-function.label: Functions and parameters
kp-function.note: Established L4; the reuse idea the sprint leans on.

kp-debug.label: Finding and naming a fault in code
kp-debug.note: Established L5. Sorting and searching are deliberately NOT here — decided 17 Jul, left for GCSE.

kp-data-insight.label: Turning query results into an insight
kp-data-insight.note: Established L6; picks up J2's kp-query for pupils who have it.

kp-ml-pattern.label: How a machine learns a pattern

kp-genai-verify.label: Checking what AI gives you
kp-genai-verify.note: Established L8. The verification habit, not the tool.

kp-ai-ethics.label: The costs and ethics of AI
kp-ai-ethics.note: Established L9, environmental cost included. Stat cards must be sourced before go-live.

kp-user-story.label: User-centred design and user stories
kp-user-story.note: Established L10; the sprint in L11 is judged against these.

kp-prototype.label: Building and testing a prototype
kp-prototype.note: Established L11. Year-One: a micro:bit gadget is one of the build mediums.

kp-accessibility.label: Making work usable by everybody
kp-accessibility.note: Established L12. New-engine flag: contrast gate and keyboard-only simulators need a prototype first.

kp-routes.label: The two GCSE routes and their shared core
kp-routes.note: Opened in L1's compass, tried out in L14/L15, decided in L16, reviewed in L17.
